record.question: Which factor reduces exposure the most?
record.explanation: Official final key: C — Increasing the distance. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 4, printed Q66. Source limitation: The question asks which factor reduces exposure “the most” but gives no geometry, shielding material, or exposure setup. Distance, shielding, and collimation act on different exposure components; no unique ranking follows. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
